readerCopy.body: A little more access, support, or confidence can turn a possibility into something concrete enough to test. When Jupiter sextiles the North Node, expansion and forward movement cooperate through a mentor, course, introduction, grant, trip, audience, or piece of good news. The opening is useful because it lowers the cost of finding out, not because it guarantees the result. A possible direction becomes easier to judge once it has enough backing to meet reality.
